summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10). Installed mariadb-server + mariadb-server-galera + galera, wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on each node with wsrep_cluster_address="gcomm://node1,node2,node3" and per-node wsrep_node_address/name, opened firewalld ports 3306/4567/4568/4444 (tcp) and 4567 (udp), populated /etc/hosts from CLUSTER_HOSTS, bootstrapped node1 with galera_new_cluster, then started mariadb on node2 and node3 which joined via SST (rsync). Verified writes on any node propagate to the others, verified the cluster stays available (Primary, quorum) when one node is stopped and writes still succeed, and verified the stopped node auto-resyncs (IST) and catches up on data when restarted. Then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id + cluster health baseline, issued a backgrounded `reboot` per node so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until each node's exec became reachable again, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed each node rejoined the cluster (wsrep_cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced) with the test data intact before moving to the next node. mariadb.service is enabled on all three nodes for boot persistence.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, galera on all 3 nodes
Added CLUSTER_HOSTS entries to /etc/hosts on all 3 nodes
Opened firewalld ports 3306/4567/4568/4444 tcp + 4567 udp on all 3 nodes
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf with wsrep settings per node
Bootstrapped Galera cluster on node1 via galera_new_cluster
Started mariadb on node2 and node3, joining cluster via rsync SST
Created galeratest.t table, wrote on node2, verified read on node1/node3
Stopped mariadb on node3, wrote on node1 while cluster at size 2 (Primary), verified write visible on node2
Restarted node3, verified automatic IST resync and data presence
Captured boot_id + cluster/data health baseline on all 3 nodes

Rebooted node1, node2, node3 one at a time (backgrounded reboot for ack-before-disconnect), polled until reachable, verified changed boot_id and full cluster recovery (size 3, Primary, Synced, data intact) before proceeding to next node
Verified systemctl is-enabled mariadb on all 3 nodes post-restart

evidence.requirement: 3-node Galera cluster formed, writes visible from other members
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped, node2/node3 joined via SST; wsrep_cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced; row written on node2 read back identically on node1 and node3

evidence.requirement: Cluster stays available with one member down; writes still succeed
evidence.summary: node3 stopped; node1 still Primary at cluster size 2 and accepted a new write; node2 confirmed seeing the new row while node3 was down

evidence.requirement: Automatic resynchronization of a returned member
evidence.summary: node3 restarted, automatically performed IST, rejoined at cluster size 3 Synced, and contained the row written while it was offline
